entities.summary: Ivonne Passada Leoncini was a Uruguayan professor and politician belonging to the Broad Front. From 3 March 2015, she served as a senator replacing Eduardo Bonomi, who was ratified as Minister of the Interior for the Broad Front government installed on 1 March.
